audience: small businesses and sales teams who manage customers, quotes and invoices in Sellsy

useCases.title: Find late or unpaid invoices
useCases.text: Searches invoices by status, such as due or late, date, currency or related company, and lists the payments on an invoice.

useCases.title: Look up a company with its contacts and quotes
useCases.text: Finds a company by name, email, VAT or other fields, lists its contacts, and searches the estimates linked to a company.

useCases.title: Review open opportunities in the pipeline
useCases.text: Searches opportunities by pipeline, step, status, amount, owner or due date, and lists the pipelines and their steps.

useCases.title: Create an opportunity for a customer
useCases.text: Looks up the pipeline and its steps, then creates an opportunity linked to a company, individual or contact.

useCases.title: Add a company, individual or contact
useCases.text: Creates a company, a private individual or a contact person. Companies and individuals can be prospects, clients or suppliers.

useCases.title: Create a task or add a note to a record
useCases.text: Creates a task with a label and due date-time, or adds a note to a company, individual, contact, opportunity or document. Notes are not sent to the customer.
